prompt: A $5$-foot mailbox casts a $3$-foot shadow at the same time that a nearby office building casts a $27$-foot shadow. How tall is the building, in feet?
hint: Same sun, same moment: the two right triangles are similar.

hints.text: Same sun, same moment: the two right triangles are similar.

explanation: The mailbox and the building both stand vertically under the same sun angle, forming similar right triangles.

alternativeExplanations.title: Scale up the shadow
steps: The building's shadow is $27 \div 3 = 9$ times the mailbox's shadow.
Similar figures scale everything by the same factor, so the building is $9 \times 5 = 45$ feet tall.
